name: Revise answer
description: Records a new version of the interviewee's answer to an EARLIER, already-answered question (not the question currently being asked). Requires finalAnswer plus rawUserMessages (verbatim revision transcript). The previous version is kept as history. If that question's topic summary was already approved, the summary is flagged for regeneration. Only works before the interview is finalized; identify the question by its topic and question order from the current state, never by an ID.

inputFields.label: Final answer
inputFields.description: The interviewee's confirmed corrected answer. Save only after explicit confirmation.

inputFields.label: Raw user messages
inputFields.description: Required. The interviewee's own messages for this revision, in chronological order: the correction plus every follow-up, copied verbatim. Do not EVER paraphrase, condense, omit, or substitute the cleaned finalAnswer. This is of utmost importance. Only exception: rewrite criticism of other people (including accounts of their mistakes and their quoted words) and private details as a neutral process lesson not tied to the person.

inputFields.label: Target question order
inputFields.description: The order number (from the current state) of the earlier, already-answered question being corrected. Pair it with topicOrder when that order exists in more than one topic.

inputFields.label: Expected answer version
inputFields.description: Optional. The latest known answer-version number for that question, used as a concurrency token. A mismatch returns a conflict and no write.

inputFields.label: Topic order
inputFields.description: Optional. The order number of the topic the question belongs to. Question order repeats across topics, so send this whenever the question order alone matches more than one answered question; a conflict response names the candidate topics.
